summary: First testing pass for MoneyFlow (Spanish personal finance app). Backend: 30/30 pytest cases pass covering user, seed, full CRUD for accounts/categories/transactions/budgets/goals/debts, debt-payments flow (creates linked transaction, decrements account balance, recomputes debt, marks status='paid' at 0), summary aggregation. Frontend: Home dashboard, Tabs (Inicio/Movimientos/Informes/Más) with center FAB, FAB opens quick-menu with 6 actions, Movimientos has search input + 5 filter chips, Informes shows PieChart + BarChart + 6 time-range chips, /debts renders 5 tabs and 3 debt cards with progress, opening a debt shows circular ring, Registrar pago navigates to pay form, submitting reduces remaining and increases paid; Ajustes exposes name/currency/save/reseed. No red-screen or business-logic bugs found. Only console deprecation warnings from Expo web (shadow* and pointerEvents props) and one minor deprecation to check.

minor.issue: Update replaces the whole document with AccountCreate fields; recompute_account_balance uses initial_balance so balance is recomputed correctly, but current_balance is transiently reset by $set before recompute. Not user visible in tests, still consider updating only provided fields.
next_payment sort is lexicographic on ISO date strings which works only if all dates share the same format; document/enforce ISO-8601 with tzinfo.

issues: Expo web console emits deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Not breaking, but should be migrated for RN 0.75+/web.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings for shadow* style props on web. Migrate to boxShadow / elevation as recommended by RN. Reference: any component using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius across /app/frontend/app/**/*.tsx
props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/**/*.tsx (any View with pointerEvents prop)

action_items: Migrate deprecated RN style props: replace shadow* -> boxShadow (or platform-conditional elevation) and move pointerEvents from prop to style.
(Optional) Make PUT /api/accounts merge partial fields instead of full overwrite so callers can update just name/color without touching balance semantics.
(Optional) In more.tsx, ensure the 'Deudas y préstamos' menu row has a stable testID for easier automation (currently navigated via /debts route).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via PROJ projection - good.
Debt payment endpoint correctly creates a linked transaction (type=debt_payment for i_owe, income for they_owe), recomputes account balance and debt status, verified with end-to-end tests.
recompute_account_balance iterates ALL user transactions and filters by account_id in memory; fine for small data, but could be a Mongo aggregation for scale.
server.py is ~720 lines; consider splitting into routers per resource for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/seed twice during tests to (re)populate demo data; final DB state after tests contains the standard seed plus one extra $25 debt payment on 'Tarjeta Chase' from the frontend E2E test (Pendiente $1,775, Pagado $725). Main agent can call /api/seed again to reset if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend BASE URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env). All /api endpoints work through the preview URL. TestIDs are wired: fab-add-btn, quick-<label>, search-input, chip-<id>, range-<id>, tab-<id>, debt-<id>, pay-btn, pay-amount, confirm-pay, save-settings, reseed. Reports page renders SVG PieChart + BarChart. Debts route lives at /debts (Deudas y préstamos in Más menu).
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs to root-cause this iteration.
